address: Ul. Lungo Mare Svetog Mikule 17, Cres, 51557, Croatia
bio: You’ll find yourself on an elegant veranda (which in summer becomes a fully open terrace) overlooking the sea and the natural landscape surrounding the modern and luxurious Hotel Isolano. In this idyllic setting, a colourful and generous Mediterranean cuisine is on offer – not only seafood – celebrating local and seasonal ingredients to bring out the very best of quality produce. An excellent selection of spirits and signature cocktails served at The Lobby Bar completes the experience.
